response.sql: WITH site_totals AS (SELECT zoneref, SUM(traitcount) as feature_count FROM scanfeatures WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY zoneref), totals AS (SELECT SUM(feature_count) as total_features, COUNT(*) as num_sites FROM site_totals), shares AS (SELECT st.zoneref, st.feature_count, CAST(st.feature_count AS REAL) / t.total_features as share, 1.0 / t.num_sites as avg_share, CAST(st.feature_count AS REAL) / t.total_features - 1.0 / t.num_sites as margin FROM site_totals st CROSS JOIN totals t) SELECT zoneref, feature_count, share, margin FROM shares WHERE margin > 0 ORDER BY margin DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Average share is defined as 1 / (number of sites with non-null traitcount data), representing the share each site would receive with equal distribution. A site's margin is its actual share minus this baseline.
